description: This Kotlin source file defines a Composable UI screen named NewProfileScreen for creating and configuring a new connection profile in an Android app. It includes input fields for profile name, host username, host IP, port, and password, all styled with Material 3 components, with validation and password visibility toggle features. The code also contains helper composables for styled text fields.

methods.name: NewProfileScreen
methods.description: Defines a user interface for creating a new profile with input fields and a save button.

methods.description: A styled Material 3 TextField with a 3dp border and rounded corners.

methods.description: A styled password input field with visibility toggle, border, and rounded corners.
